reading: A micro heating-oil contract exists (D719's 'no micro' was imprecise: the repo's futures_contract_specs.json fetched nine micros and never looked for one), but it does not trade: zero volume on every one of 32 sessions and 2 contracts open. No sub-size HO contract is tradable, so D719's NOT VIABLE size reading stands.
